mechanisms: Publish target-local client and server executables with inert compiler analysis facts that nested consumers can validate without dependency source inspection.
Route all React component values through fixed precompiled client/server island and root-host artifacts instead of creating native component artifacts or adapters at runtime.
Carry native children across React ownership as opaque supplier operations whose handles expose no value kind, topology, VNode materialization, or component classification.
